profile.description: Large active Utah art/music/STEM festival. The 2026 festival had its own Kids' Area with inflatables, pirate ship playground, face painting and paid kids activity tickets.

notes.subject: Contact changed; current festival already uses inflatables
notes.body: The old December 2023 reply from Liz Amato said she had left Craft Lake City, so she should not remain the working contact. Current official contact is info@craftlakecity.com / 801-906-8521. The 2026 DIY Festival remained very active and already had a Kids' Area with bounce inflatables, a pirate ship playground, face painting and activity tickets. This may still be worth an early future partnership conversation, but not as a generic vendor pitch and not by contacting Liz.

followUps.label: Review 2027 Craft Lake City kids-area opportunity
followUps.reason: The festival is active and already uses inflatables in its Kids' Area. Check early whether they use an outside entertainment provider or have room for a larger staffed attraction area.
